<?php

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use App\Http\Controllers\HistoryController;
use App\Http\Controllers\UserController;
use App\Http\Controllers\UrlController;

/*
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| API Routes
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
|
| Here is where you can register API routes for your application. These routes are
| available for all of your application. Make sure to place them behind authentication
| to protect them from unauthorized access.
|
*/

Route::apiResource('users', UserController::class);
Route::apiResource('histories', HistoryController::class);
Route::apiResource('urls', UrlController::class);
Route::post('urls', UrlController::class)->name('url.store');
Route::post('urls/{url}/share', UrlController::class)->name('url.share');
